=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the older white-haired man in a red shirt. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (facebook.com/jim.parrett.54). A Facebook comment from Diane and a daughter tag the named subject. Photograph posted 23 June 2024. Gold 80 Powhatan, Virginia. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Jim Parrett portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Jim Parrett Facebook portrait.jpg]].
